user.title: Add a Deckify dashboard
user.description: Each Deckify dashboard gets its own entry in the sidebar. Add the integration again to create more.

data_description.url_path: Reachable at /<path>. Lowercase letters, digits, - and _.
data_description.areas: Leave empty and Deckify discovers every area automatically.

error.invalid_url: Use lowercase letters, digits, - or _ (2-40 characters).
error.reserved_url: That path is used by Home Assistant itself.
error.url_taken: A panel already exists at that path.

abort.already_configured: A Deckify dashboard already uses that path.

areas.title: Rooms
areas.description: Pick the areas this dashboard covers. Empty means every area, and new areas appear automatically.

entities.title: Devices and entities
entities.description: Deckify discovers everything by itself. Use these lists only to remove noise or change behaviour.

data.confirm: Ask before acting (entity id or prefix)

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: Leave a field empty and Deckify picks a sensor itself.

scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.description: Scenes are discovered automatically, so renaming them in the Hue app is enough. Pin the ones you always want first.

data.strip_area_prefix: Strip the room name from scene labels

reset.title: Reset layout
reset.description: Clears card order, hidden cards, sizes, groups and per-card settings for this dashboard. Rooms and sensors are kept.

behaviour.title: Behaviour
behaviour.description: Controls whether Deckify fills the dashboard for you, and whether every screen shows the same thing.

data.per_device: Let each screen keep its own layout

data_description.auto_fill: Off: the dashboard starts empty and you add rooms, cards and entities yourself. On: every room and card is added for you, and new entities appear automatically.
data_description.per_device: Off: the same layout on every device, stored on the server. On: tablet, phone and desktop can each have their own order, hidden cards and colours, stored in the browser.
